target_customer: Non-technical business teams that want custom internal software without hiring engineers
problem: Off-the-shelf SaaS does not fit team workflows and building custom tools needs engineers that operations and finance teams lack.
business_model: AI-native software agency with managed builds plus a hosted workspace; later self-serve plans reported

founders.name: Jorrie Brettin
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no background. The YC page also shows BrowserBook and Chorrie as related launches.

technical_complexity.rationale: Delivering apps with AI code generation plus a hosted workspace is standard engineering; the service element carries the difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Agency services with AI tooling are easy to copy and AI app builders were multiplying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; later sources show many AI internal-tool builders emerged.

market_need_then: Teams complain that low-code tools like Retool still require SQL or JavaScript knowledge (reviewer comments, undated). Demand evidence at the 2024 batch date was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain promise: custom software ready in days, no engineers needed.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Browser agents for healthcare workflows (per a YC snippet that mentions pre-pivot days)

outcome_analysis: Kilvin is active with a three person team and no public funding found. It appears to have pivoted from browser agents to an AI-native software agency. Self-serve plans are reported by a low-confidence source, and the agency model faces many AI app builders, so the story is unclear.
notes: No funding found in any source; one cross-check search found only aggregator profiles with no figures, so funding is unknown, not zero. Pivot detail comes from a single search snippet of a YC page and is unverified. Built In page is LLM generated and not used. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found.
